data.body: Not a 0.16.0 release blocker, so I removed the release-0.16.0 tag. rebar has never had `--version` (v0.15.1 lacks it too). `docs/releasing.md` §5 doesn't list it in the smoke test, and nothing delivered in 0.16.0 touches it. Adding it means adding a new CLI flag or subcommand, so it's a feature decision for the operator, not a bug fix. The options the release-candidate checker proposed: (1) a top-level `--version` printing the version and commit; (2) a `rebar version` subcommand with `-o json`; (3) close as wontfix. This ticket stays open until the operator chooses.
